about: What a run does (S37 q3): a command (kind run, its arguments base64, in order), an instruction to an agent (kind agent, from a recipe or -), or a deploy's apply (kind deploy, M219: which deploy, its driver and the hash of the operation its owner approved, and nothing else), for one daemon, in a directory (base64) or -. Its bytes are what a run's hash, its standing grant and any approval name, so the daemon reads them back only from exactly the bytes encode makes: an extra line, one out of place, another version, bad base64, or a deploy with a command each refuse.

arugula op v1
daemon d1
kind run
session -
pane - -
cwd L3c=
argv bWFrZQ==
argv aXQncw==
